title: My Brother Has Sickle Cell
author: Erica D. Gamble
mlbSummary: Told from a younger brother's point of view, this story follows a family as a child learns why his older brother sometimes has severe pain, needs medicine, and goes to the hospital. It gives siblings a concrete way to understand sickle cell disease while preserving the everyday relationship between the brothers.
